design.name: 雪狌狌
design.brief: A pack-hunting snow monkey based on the xingxing (狌狌) of the Shan Hai Jing, 'shaped like a macaque with white ears, it crawls and walks like a man', modelled on the Chinese golden snub-nosed monkey of the snowy mountains (NOT a yeti, NOT a gorilla): a stocky, long-armed monkey with a bright sky-blue bare face, a tiny upturned snub nose, big expressive eyes and a wide mischievous grin, white ear tufts, a thick cape of long golden-white fur over the shoulders and back ending in icy blue tips, a short thick tail. A cluster of big faceted blue ice crystals grows out of its shoulders and spine, and one bright glowing cyan ice crystal is set in its forehead (weak spot). Scraps of a frozen pilgrim's vermilion prayer cord with small bronze bells around one wrist. Big hands with a clearly separate thumb and four fingers; hand-like feet with five toes. Cheeky, fast and annoying, dangerous in a pack.
design.weapon: no weapon: mid-leap with both huge fists raised over its head to smash the ground, a chunk of ice clutched in one fist
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the desert roster (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast): chunky simplified masses, oversized head and hands or paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges, ice as a few big faceted crystal shapes (never thin needles or noisy frost texture), fur as a few large carved clumps.
design.turnaround_pose: standing upright on its hind legs like a monkey standing up, knees slightly bent, feet a little apart; the long arms held a little away from the body in a relaxed A-pose, both hands open and EMPTY (no ice chunk, nothing held); the short tail hanging down behind; head facing straight ahead, mouth closed with a slight grin; the forehead crystal painted as opaque bright cyan (no halo); the shoulder and spine ice crystals as solid faceted shapes; the golden-white fur cape as a few big carved clumps
design.turnaround_digits: each hand with a separate thumb and four fingers and each foot with five separate toes (a thumb-like big toe), clearly countable; the ice crystals, the tail and the fur cape fully inside the frame.
